label: Homestead Wheat
waterProfile: Prefers steady moisture and tolerates brief drought.
notes: Baseline pacing crop tuned for new players; anchors tutorial economy.
localizationNotes: 'Homestead' can localize to culturally equivalent starter-farm term if needed.

label: Riverbank Potato
waterProfile: High moisture demand; wilts quickly if ignored.
notes: Bulky harvest to encourage cook/sell loops; offsets longer grow time.
localizationNotes: 'Riverbank' evokes damp soil; translators may adapt imagery for regional wetlands.

label: Shade Berry Bush
waterProfile: Moderate moisture needs; rewards consistent watering.
notes: Repeat harvest option to teach regrow mechanic and upkeep cadence.
localizationNotes: Use 'Bush' equivalent matching local flora references; keep friendly tone.

label: Starseed Orchid
waterProfile: Requires high nighttime moisture; benefits from moonlit festivals.
notes: Festival reward crop with strong sell price but long growth cycle.
localizationNotes: 'Starseed' and 'Radiant' should stay fantastical; allow synonyms for 'Orchid'.

label: Comet Corn
waterProfile: Thrives in stormy weather; loses progress if parched.
notes: High-yield regrower that pairs with weather control upgrades.
localizationNotes: Alliteration intentional; keep 'Comet Corn' unless target language lacks hard 'c'.

label: Lunar Lily
waterProfile: Needs gentle watering; overwatering delays bloom.
notes: Late-game floral for festival crafting and premium gifts.
localizationNotes: 'Lunar' should align with moon imagery; translators may choose culturally relevant lunar term.
